title: 积分达人揭秘：信用卡积分如何玩出高价值
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: How did the website start? What was the first week like the first month?
segments.zh: 这个网站是怎么起步的？第一周、第一个月是什么情况？

segments.en: The first week of 2010? I was working at Morgan Stanley.
segments.zh: 2010年第一周？我当时在摩根士丹利工作。

segments.en: I was a corporate recruiter going to all the college career fairs. And I was so good with my points because I would put all of the career fairs on my corporate amics.
segments.zh: 我是企业招聘人员，参加各种大学招聘会。我很擅长用积分，因为我把所有招聘会费用都记在公司卡上。

segments.en: And you could call. And for $95 a year, you could get all the points.
segments.zh: 你可以打电话，每年花95美元就能获得所有积分。

segments.en: So I became the guy, the expense guy at Morgan Stanley. I put all the career fairs on my credit card.
segments.zh: 所以我成了摩根士丹利的费用达人，把所有招聘会费用都刷在我的信用卡上。

segments.en: So I was raking in the point. So I started the points guy. It's just like a way to share my tips as a corporate traveler.
segments.zh: 所以我攒了很多积分。我创办了“积分先生”，就是为了分享我作为商务旅行者的技巧。

segments.en: And within 11 months, it just blew up.
So it took off. Your book had a win at travel came out in 2025, in which you really lay out your thesis.
segments.zh: 所以它起飞了。你的书《旅行中的胜利》在2025年出版，你在书中详细阐述了你的论点。

segments.en: That points are real and non-liquid assets. They are a currency.
segments.zh: 积分是真实且非流动的资产，它们是一种货币。

segments.en: My question to you is, how much devaluation have we seen in this currency after the pandemic ended and the world embarked on revenge travel?
segments.zh: 我的问题是，疫情结束后，世界掀起报复性旅行潮，这种货币贬值了多少？

segments.en: Yeah, so the airlines are just planes.
segments.zh: 是的，航空公司其实就是飞机。
他们实际上是伪装成航空公司的银行。

segments.en: The loyalty business is bigger than ever. It's which driving all the profit.
segments.zh: 忠诚度业务比以往任何时候都大，它驱动着所有利润。

segments.en: You see Delta and United are just doing incredibly because of their co-brand portfolio.
segments.zh: 你会发现达美和美联航因为他们的联名卡组合而表现极佳。

segments.en: So yes, there isn't increase in inflation how many miles it takes to get a flight.
segments.zh: 所以，是的，通货膨胀导致兑换航班所需的里程数增加了。

segments.en: In general, but the foreign frequent flyer programs, that's where the value is.
segments.zh: 但总的来说，外国常旅客计划才是价值所在。

segments.en: So for example, flying blue, which is Air France's program, they have 60,000 mile business class awards all throughout the year.
segments.zh: 例如，法航的蓝天飞行计划，全年都有6万里程的商务舱奖励。

segments.en: That's a herd of. The same flight using Delta Sky Miles can be 500,000 points.
segments.zh: 这很划算。同样的航班用达美里程可能需要50万积分。
